title: Lavington NSW - Maintain the Network
current_summary:
Lavington, NSW. The planned maintenance was scheduled for 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on 15 October 2026 and was completed at 1:07 AM AEDT.

This planned work is to apply a permanent fix in place of the temporary repairs implemented to restore services during a recent network outage. Work may need to be performed during daylight hours for safety reasons, please refer to the estimated Scheduled Start Date for confirmation.

nbn® is completing repairs on the nbn network in your area. This will cause your nbn service to lose connection.

This work may be carried out during daylight hours due to local noise limits and safety requirements.

Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected while your service is offline. Minimise disruption to your routine by downloading required files and switching to offline work modes.

updates.content: We will be supporting planned maintenance on the access network in Lavington, NSW. Some services in the area will be offline during the window on 15 October 2026 between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT. Our team will monitor progress with our network partner and confirm when services are restored. If you rely on your connection, please plan for downtime and consider a mobile hotspot where available. Thank you for your patience.
The planned maintenance in Lavington, NSW has started. Affected services may be offline until the window is due to end at 6:00 AM AEDT on 15 October 2026.
The planned maintenance in Lavington, NSW has been completed, earlier than the 6:00 AM AEDT end of the window.
